items.headline: Accenture stock tumbles over 17% after fiscal Q3 2026 revenue miss and weaker full-year sales guidance
Accenture increases fiscal 2026 share repurchase program by $2 billion to $7.5 billion, boosting planned shareholder returns to $11.5 billion
Accenture reports fiscal Q3 2026 revenue of $18.7 billion and diluted EPS of $3.80, both up year over year
